description: OMOP CDM v5.4 PROVIDER table — unique identifiers for healthcare providers. Providers include physicians (MDs and DOs), nurses (RNs and LPNs), and others involved in healthcare delivery.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Provider.

fields.label: NPI
fields.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider.

fields.label: DEA
fields.description: The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) number of the provider.

fields.label: Specialty Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Standard Specialty Concept ID in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.label: Care Site ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the main Care Site where the provider is practicing.

fields.label: Year Of Birth
fields.description: The year of birth of the Provider.

fields.label: Provider Source Value
fields.description: The identifier used for the Provider in the source data, stored here for reference.

fields.label: Specialty Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the specialty as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Specialty Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source for the Provider specialty.

fields.label: Gender Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the gender of the Provider as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Gender Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source for the gender of the Provider.
